essential.targets: Single-joint quads (vastus lateralis/medialis/intermedius), with adductor magnus, glute max, and soleus
cues: Start at the bottom in full knee flexion with full foot contact
Flat back; push the footplate away through the full range

essential.targets: Rectus femoris (the two-joint quad, not hit by hip+knee extension) plus single-joint quads; develops the lower rectus femoris
cues: Drive the toes toward the ceiling
Align the knee with the machine pivot; control the eccentric

essential.targets: Two-joint hamstrings (biceps femoris long head, semitendinosus, semimembranosus) plus BF short head; semitendinosus emphasis
cues: Lean forward to increase hip flexion (lengthens the hamstrings)
Align the knee with the pivot; drive the heels toward the seat, controlled

essential.targets: Gluteus maximus (more hip-dominant than the hip thrust due to the shorter knee moment arm); adductor magnus, single-joint quads, hamstrings
cues: Barbell over the hips; drive the hips to the ceiling to full extension
Brace the abs; squeeze the glutes at the top

essential.targets: Gastrocnemii (straight-leg position keeps them long) and soleus
cues: Keep the knee extended; dorsiflex into a deep stretch
Pause ~4s in the stretch; vary toe angle to bias the medial/lateral heads

essential.targets: Pectoralis major (loaded stretched; clavicular + sternal heads), with anterior deltoid and triceps
cues: ~30-degree incline; grip slightly wider than the shoulders
Start with the shoulder horizontally extended (pec stretched); full range to the upper chest
Start with the shoulder adducted in the frontal plane
High-stability machine; control the eccentric

essential.targets: Anterior deltoid (steep incline brings the middle delts in too), with pecs and triceps
cues: Steep incline with a frontal-plane start below shoulder height
Press through the full range

essential.targets: Triceps brachii long head (shoulder in the anatomical position, elbow flexed)
cues: Shoulder in the anatomical position, elbow flexed at the start
Peak force where the cable is perpendicular to the forearm

essential.targets: Latissimus dorsi (lumbopelvic region emphasis), teres major, elbow flexors
cues: Wide grip; start with the shoulders abducted overhead
Pull to the upper chest; control the stretch

essential.targets: Latissimus dorsi (thoracic region), with traps and rhomboids for scapular retraction
cues: Narrow grip (closer to the sagittal plane)
Row and retract the scapulae

essential.targets: Posterior deltoid (wide grip moves it toward the transverse plane), with traps and rhomboids
cues: Wide grip, shoulder horizontally extended
Lead with the elbows out; retract the scapulae

essential.targets: All elbow flexors evenly (biceps long + short heads, brachialis, brachioradialis); no peak load at full extension so it does not bias one
cues: Machine path keeps load even across the range
Mid-range peak; control through the full range
